subject: Preboarding controls & onboarding screening pack — request and quick sync
messages:
From: Sara Bloom <sara@aurora-sec.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: quick preboarding controls & screening artifacts

Hi Neha —

Thanks again for taking this. Aurora is running a SIG + SOC 2 readiness review and our compliance team asked for a compact set of artifacts specifically focused on employee screening and onboarding/offboarding controls for vendor-integrated services. To keep the ask small, could you share the following as a starter?

- Training completion logs (last 12 months) for security awareness and data handling (redacted OK)
- Redacted background-check evidence for a small sample cohort (contractors + full-time; please redact PII)
- Onboarding checklist showing IAM provisioning steps and owner (for both cloud and G-Suite/Drive)
- Offboarding/deprovisioning checklist and typical latency (time-to-remove) for terminated contractors
- A short description of how you capture training attestation and where logs are stored (SaaS/tool names ok)

If you can attach 1–2 sample files (redacted_bg_sample.pdf, onboarding_controls_summary.csv) and confirm a 30-min sync tomorrow afternoon, that would let us close the loop quickly. If there's a Drive folder or HubSpot record we should reference, send the link.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Sara Bloom
Compliance Program Manager
Aurora HealthTech
(sara@aurora-sec.com)

Attachment: aurora_request_form.csv (stub)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Bloom <sara@aurora-sec.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Jul 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: quick preboarding controls & screening artifacts

Hi Sara —

Thanks — we can definitely help. I'm attaching a brief controls summary (onboarding_controls_summary.csv) and a redacted sample BG doc (redacted_bg_sample.pdf) to start. Both files are scrubbed for PII and represent the contractor + FT samples you asked for.

High-level answers inline:
- Training logs: We store attestations in LearnHub (internal LMS) and export quarterly CSVs for audit. Retention: 24 months by default; exports are retained in our compliance Drive folder.
- Background checks: Performed via SecureScreen vendor; we keep hashed IDs and redacted PDFs in our compliance vault; originals are not shared.
- IAM provisioning: Onboarding checklist (attached row in CSV) includes task owner, ticket ID, and whether access is gated by manager approval.
- Offboarding: Typical latency is <8 hours for critical access (SAML/IDP) and up to 48 hours for third-party tools that require manual revocation. We include examples in the CSV.

I've proposed a 30-min call at 2:30pm PT tomorrow (Wed 7/12). If Marcus (ops) or Jonas (legal) want to join, great — looping them now.

Best,

Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: onboarding_controls_summary.csv (stub), redacted_bg_sample.pdf (stub)

Neha/Sara —

Thanks for sharing the samples, Neha. The CSV layout is helpful. Two quick follow-ups before the call:

1) For the redacted BG sample, can you confirm that vendor reference checks are included in the original (we only need confirmation, not the raw reports)?
2) Could you include the contractor deprovisioning timeline when access is terminated mid-project? We want to validate SLA adherence for third-party tools (e.g., analytics buckets, Snowflake access).

We'll be on the proposed 2:30pm PT tomorrow. Adding our internal compliance engineer to the calendar invite.
